title: Vocal · console + compressor + EQ
settings_summary: Spanda EQ (90 Hz high-pass, -2.5 dB at 300 Hz, +2 dB at 3 kHz, +3 dB air shelf at 10 kHz), Dynamics (VCA Smooth, 3:1, -26 dB threshold, 8 ms / 150 ms, auto makeup) and Console (Signature)

title: Drums · Dynamics + Limiter
settings_summary: Dynamics (FET, Balanced, 4:1, -22 dB threshold, 20 ms attack, 80 ms release) into Limiter (Transient mode, 6 dB drive, -1 dBTP ceiling)

title: Full mix · bus chain
settings_summary: Bus chain: Console (Signature), Tape (+2 dB drive), Dynamics (VCA Bus Snap, 2:1, 30 ms / 300 ms), EQ (+1.5 dB low and high shelves), Limiter (Smooth, 3 dB, -1 dBTP)

title: Pad · moving filter
settings_summary: Drive filter, LP 24, 900 Hz cutoff, resonance 70, movement LFO (sine, 1 bar, depth 36), chorus 30 %, delay 15 %

title: Drums · Comb +
settings_summary: Comb + filter at 420 Hz, resonance 85, envelope 20, filter mix 60 %, chorus and delay off

title: Bass · resonant ladder LP
settings_summary: Ladder filter, LP 24, 350 Hz cutoff, resonance 95, +6 dB drive, envelope 40 with 220 ms decay, chorus and delay off

title: Bass · Tube
settings_summary: Stage A Tube shape, 18 dB drive, 9 kHz post low-pass, 100 % wet; capture and cab off
